Who’s teaching

Hi, I’m Thomas.

I teach conversation and pronunciation to working adults—especially people who read English far better than they can speak it.

TM

I’m Thomas—born and raised in the United States, now living in Chiapas, Mexico. I work with developers, professionals, travelers, and anyone who wants English to feel usable rather than theoretical.

Most students already know more grammar than they think. What is missing is often the reflex. We talk about real life, catch the exact pattern that causes friction, make it understandable, and drill it until the better form arrives faster.

The goal is simple: leave every session having said something real, with one more part of English feeling clear and available.
